subject: SPEC-035: Memory Versioning System Implementation
description:
Implement comprehensive versioning system for memories, enabling version history tracking, version lineage, and version metadata management.

**Requirements:**
- Design versioning data model (version table schema)
- Implement version creation and storage
- Support automatic version creation on memory updates
- Maintain version lineage and relationships
- Store version metadata (timestamp, user, change description)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Version table created with proper schema
- Versions are automatically created on memory updates
- Version lineage is maintained correctly
- Version metadata is stored and retrievable
- API endpoints support version operations

**Dependencies:**
- SPEC-044 (Memory Drift Detection) - foundation
- Database schema migration required

subject: SPEC-035: Version History Tracking API
description:
Build API endpoints for retrieving version history, version details, and version comparison functionality.

**Requirements:**
- GET /memory/{memory_id}/versions - List all versions
- GET /memory/{memory_id}/versions/{version_id} - Get version details
- GET /memory/{memory_id}/versions/{version_id}/diff - Compare versions
- Support pagination and filtering for version history
- Include version metadata in responses

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- All version endpoints implemented
- Version history is paginated
- Version comparison returns detailed diff
- API responses include full metadata
- Performance <200ms for typical queries

**Dependencies:**
- Versioning system (US#341) must be complete

subject: SPEC-035: Snapshot Restore and Rollback
description:
Implement snapshot restore and rollback functionality, allowing users to restore memories to specific snapshots or rollback to previous versions.

**Requirements:**
- POST /memory/{memory_id}/restore - Restore to specific snapshot
- POST /memory/{memory_id}/rollback - Rollback to previous version
- Support selective restore (partial memory restoration)
- Validate restore operations with ACL checks
- Create audit log entries for restore operations

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Restore to snapshot works correctly
- Rollback to previous version functions properly
- ACL permissions are checked before restore
- Restore operations are logged in audit trail
- Selective restore supports partial updates

**Dependencies:**
- SPEC-043 (Memory ACL) - for permission checks
- SPEC-071 (Audit Logging) - for audit entries

subject: SPEC-035: Enhanced Snapshot Management API
description:
Enhance existing snapshot API endpoints to support full snapshot lifecycle management, including snapshot listing, deletion, and metadata management.

**Requirements:**
- Extend existing POST /drift/snapshot endpoint
- GET /memory/{memory_id}/snapshots - List all snapshots
- DELETE /memory/{memory_id}/snapshots/{snapshot_id} - Delete snapshot
- PUT /memory/{memory_id}/snapshots/{snapshot_id}/metadata - Update snapshot metadata
- Support snapshot tagging and categorization

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- All snapshot management endpoints work
- Snapshot listing is paginated and filterable
- Snapshot deletion respects ACL permissions
- Metadata updates are validated
- Snapshot operations are performant

**Dependencies:**
- Existing snapshot API (server/memory_drift_api.py)
- SPEC-043 (ACL) - for permission enforcement

subject: SPEC-035: Version Diff Visualization
description:
Implement version comparison and diff visualization, showing changes between memory versions with enhanced diff display.

**Requirements:**
- Enhanced diff algorithm for memory content comparison
- Visual diff display (text diff, semantic diff)
- Diff statistics (lines changed, similarity score)
- Integration with SPEC-044 drift detection for semantic diff
- API endpoint for diff generation

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Diff visualization is accurate
- Semantic diff uses embedding comparison
- Diff statistics are calculated correctly
- Diff display is clear and readable
- Performance is acceptable (<1s for typical diffs)

**Dependencies:**
- SPEC-044 (Memory Drift Detection) - for semantic comparison
- SPEC-031 (Relevance Ranking) - for similarity scoring

subject: SPEC-035: Snapshot Versioning UI Components
description:
Build frontend UI components for snapshot and version management in customer and admin consoles.

**Requirements:**
- Snapshot list view with version history
- Version comparison UI component
- Restore/rollback action buttons
- Snapshot metadata editor
- Version timeline visualization

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Version history is displayed clearly
- Users can compare versions visually
- Restore actions are confirmed before execution
- Snapshot metadata is editable
- Version timeline shows progression

**Dependencies:**
- Backend API endpoints (previous stories)
- Frontend shared components

subject: SPEC-035: CLI Commands for Snapshot Management
description:
Implement CLI commands for snapshot and version management, enabling command-line operations for power users.

**Requirements:**
- `mem snapshot create <memory_id>` - Create snapshot
- `mem snapshot list <memory_id>` - List snapshots
- `mem version history <memory_id>` - Show version history
- `mem version restore <memory_id> <version_id>` - Restore version
- `mem version diff <memory_id> <version1> <version2>` - Compare versions

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- All CLI commands work correctly
- Commands provide clear output
- Error handling is comprehensive
- Commands support JSON output format
- Help documentation is complete

**Dependencies:**
- Backend API endpoints
- CLI infrastructure

subject: SPEC-035: Snapshot Versioning Test Suite
description:
Create comprehensive test suite for SPEC-035 features including unit tests, integration tests, and E2E tests.

**Requirements:**
- Unit tests for versioning operations
- Integration tests for snapshot workflow
- E2E tests for restore/rollback scenarios
- Performance tests for version history queries
- Edge case testing (concurrent updates, large histories)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Test coverage >90% for versioning code
- All integration tests pass
- E2E tests cover critical workflows
- Performance tests validate query optimization
- Edge cases are handled correctly

**Dependencies:**
- All SPEC-035 implementation stories
- Test infrastructure
